scenes.en: Protect your eyes while you study.
scenes.say: Studying late for board exams? Here's how to protect your eyes.

scenes.en: Reading up close keeps a tiny eye muscle working hard. Hours of it = strain.
scenes.ta: அருகில் படிக்கும்போது கண் தசை கடினமாக வேலை செய்யும்
scenes.say: When you read up close, a tiny muscle inside the eye works hard to keep words in focus. Hours without rest bring eye strain, headaches and blur.

scenes.en: Room light on + a desk lamp from the side, opposite your writing hand.
scenes.say: Do keep the room light on, and add a desk lamp from the side, opposite your writing hand, so there are no shadows.

scenes.en: Don't study in a dark room with only a bright screen.
scenes.say: Don't study in a dark room with only a bright screen or one small light.

scenes.en: Book 35–40 cm away. Sit upright. Every 20 min, look far for 20 sec.
scenes.say: Do sit upright, keep your book about thirty five to forty centimetres away, and every twenty minutes, look far away for twenty seconds.

scenes.en: Time outdoors in daylight helps lower the risk of short sight in children.
scenes.ta: பகல் வெளிச்சத்தில் வெளியே நேரம் செலவிடுவது கண்ணுக்கு நல்லது
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show that time outdoors in daylight helps lower the risk of short sight in children. So take short breaks outside.

scenes.en: Tired eyes and a tired brain don't learn well.
scenes.say: And get enough sleep. Tired eyes and a tired brain don't learn well.

scenes.en: Get an eye test before exams.
scenes.say: If the board looks blurry or you get frequent headaches, get an eye test before your exams.
